title: AI Photo Retouching Quality Checklist
reuse: You may copy, adapt and use the original checklist text and blank forms in commercial or personal workflows. Attribution to Curify is appreciated, not required. Example photographs, trademarks and third-party assets are excluded from this permission.

checks.review: Confirm the source image IDs, authorized use, output dimensions, background, colour reference, deadline and reviewer before editing.
checks.decision: Hold if scope or source permissions are unresolved.

checks.review: Compare each face at the same zoom: age, facial proportions, eyes, mouth and distinctive marks.
Inspect forehead, cheeks and neck for waxy smoothing, patchy colour, repeated texture and lost pores.
checks.decision: Rework visible texture loss outside the agreed finish.

checks.review: Compare flyaways, hairline, eyelashes, veil edges and fine fur against light and dark backgrounds.
checks.decision: Rework halos, missing strands and cut-out edges.

checks.review: Count fingers; inspect joints, limb boundaries, feet and overlapping subjects.
checks.decision: Hold added, missing or malformed anatomy.

checks.review: Compare neckline, sleeves, hem, seams, fasteners, lace and folds with the source.
checks.decision: Hold changes to product construction or fit claims.

checks.review: Check plaid continuity, embroidery, labels, lettering and logo placement.
checks.decision: Hold altered branding, illegible labels or invented pattern details.

checks.review: Review leather grain, satin sheen, suede nap, metal and stone facets. Do not mistake stronger highlights for accurate material.
checks.decision: Hold misleading product properties; rework accidental texture loss.

checks.review: Inspect prongs, engraving, stone count and shape, band thickness and reflections at equal scale.
checks.decision: Hold changed construction, added stones or misleading gemstone appearance.

checks.review: Compare to an agreed reference on the same colour-managed display; check white balance and product hue across the batch.
checks.decision: Escalate colour-critical uncertainty; do not invent numerical tolerances.

checks.review: Check for invented or missing objects, warped architecture and mismatched horizons.
checks.decision: Hold undisclosed scene changes outside the brief.

checks.review: Check contact shadows, direction, softness and reflections. Confirm that products and feet sit on the surface.
checks.decision: Rework floating products or inconsistent light.

checks.review: Align source and output where framing should be retained. Inspect stretch, scale, rotation and perspective.
checks.decision: Hold an unapproved crop or geometry change.

checks.review: Inspect the boundary around each requested edit at 100% and at intended viewing size.
checks.decision: Rework seams, blur patches and repeated cloned texture.

checks.review: Open exported files; verify actual pixel dimensions, format, colour profile, orientation and agreed watermark state.
checks.decision: Hold unreadable files or a delivery format that misses the brief.

checks.review: Review a contact sheet, then inspect each critical item individually. Cover every lighting condition, material, pose and processing variant.
checks.decision: Expand review when a sampled defect suggests a repeated failure.

checks.review: Record input ID, output version, requested change, reviewer, decision and evidence crop. Recheck corrected files.
checks.decision: Hold unresolved critical issues; do not overwrite the audit trail.

checks.review: Confirm agreed scope, all critical checks, outstanding rework and the approving person.
checks.decision: Release only explicitly approved versions; an average score cannot override a critical failure.
